hooks.text: 十三种武器按不同格数塞入有限车载网格
hooks.excerpt: your vehicle has limited grid slots, and each weapon occupies a different number of slots. Machine guns, flamethrowers, rockets, heavy cannons, shock towers, laser cannons... 13 unique weapons await your unlock.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 第四章后解锁多辆战车，各有专属技能树与升级路线
hooks.excerpt: New vehicles are unlocked after Chapter 4! Each vehicle not only has a unique appearance but also possesses its own skill tree and upgrade path . Some specialize in firepower suppression, others lean toward defense and survival, while some focus on resource acquisition.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 挂机资源用于装备抽取、加速升级与碎片永久强化
hooks.excerpt: Each battle allows you to accumulate resources for: Equipment Drawing : Randomly obtain powerful weapons or accessories Purchasing Coins : Accelerate weapon and vehicle upgrades Unlocking Fragments : Permanently enhance weapon attributes
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
